scope: static declared first-load inventory only; no browser observation or release/performance verdict

compression.algorithm: Python gzip.compress(level=9, mtime=0), per-file sum; identical SHA content shared
compression.meaning: normalized gzip sizes, not HTTP compression; Node/zlib may produce different gzip bytes

method.closure: HTML executable scripts/styles/preload/eager images; static imports and audited eager islands boot glue/wasm; CSS urls/imports conservative
method.excluded: navigation/download/OG/canonical, templates/noscript, lazy images, unexecuted dynamic import/new URL literals
method.inline_icon: data URI icon has no network edge; its bytes are already in the verified HTML
method.actual_vs_declared: implicit native-browser requests (e.g. favicon.ico), viewport/media-dependent CSS/fonts and srcset choices require actual response cross-check; this tool does not fabricate those observations
method.page_totals: each verified HTML file plus its shared non-HTML dependency set; raw and gzip maxima retain ties
method.hashes: inventory, dependency-set and per-page closure SHA256 are sorted UTF8 path+space+fileSHA+newline digests; appended from verified cached metrics without a second compression/read batch
